owner_posts.post_text:
Semi-Automatic Sliding Partition for Office Cabins

A sliding partition system that only needs a small push to initiate movement. A motorized mechanism handles the rest, opening or closing the panel smoothly without manual effort.

It's designed for office cabins, corner cabins with L-shaped tracks, meeting rooms, co-working spaces, and reception areas. Anywhere that needs to switch between open and private layouts through the day.

The appeal is that it sits between a basic manual system (which can feel heavy with daily use) and a fully automatic one (which adds cost and complexity). You get motorized assistance with a manual trigger, practical, smooth, and cost-effective.

Available at Elegant Spaces, Showroom No. 9, S.V. Road, Santacruz West, Mumbai 400054.

Video Door Phone with Smart Lock: See Who's at Your Door Before You Open It

You spend crores buying and renovating your dream home down to the last detail. But the moment someone rings the doorbell, you are blind. You have no idea who's standing outside. Is it a neighbor, a delivery person, or someone you'd rather not open the door to? You simply don't know.

So what do you do? You get up, walk to the door, and squint through a peephole just to catch a glimpse. And even then, having an actual conversation through it is nearly impossible.

The Solution: Video Door Phone with Smart Lock Integration
An outdoor unit installed at your entrance streams live video to an indoor screen the moment someone rings. You see exactly who's outside before you decide whether to engage at all. No guessing, no walking over blind.
The system also sends real-time alerts directly to your phone, so you stay connected to your front door whether you're in another room, at work, or out of town. And from the same app, you can speak to the visitor and unlock the door remotely without being physically present.

Address: Elegant Spaces, Showroom No. 9, S.V. Road, Santacruz West, Mumbai 400054

Fingerprint Lock in a Mortise Handle: Smart Security Without Ruining Your Interior Design Architects design every room on a theme, matching the decor, handles, and premium door hardware throughout the house. Then the client says: I want a fingerprint lock on my master bedroom. The usual fix is a bulky digital door lock with a large plate that ruins the entire look. This fingerprint mortise handle lock solves that. It integrates a biometric fingerprint scanner directly into a standard mortise handle, the same handle used on every other bedroom door in the house. No extra unit, no large plate, no design compromise. Press your finger, the smart lock for bedroom doors disengages, and you walk in. Lock it manually from inside for full privacy. If the battery dies, a hidden keyhole lets you open it with a physical key. Available in multiple designs and finishes to match any premium door hardware theme, matte black, chrome, brushed gold, or antique brass. Italian Folding Wall Bed Hardware Mechanism | Space-Saving Bed Solutions in Mumbai

Transform compact spaces into functional living areas with our premium Italian folding wall bed hardware mechanism, designed for modern homes where space optimisation is essential. This Murphy bed mechanism is ideal for bedrooms, studio apartments, guest rooms, home offices, and multi-purpose spaces.

Manufactured in Italy, the system features a complete heavy-duty metal frame with high-quality wooden slats, ensuring superior strength, durability, and long-term reliability. The advanced hydraulic lifting mechanism allows smooth, effortless operation, making the bed easy to open and close with minimal effort and maximum safety.

When not in use, the bed folds neatly into the wall, freeing up valuable floor space without compromising on comfort or aesthetics. This mechanism supports custom finishes and furniture designs, making it suitable for both residential and commercial projects.

At Elegant Hardware, we specialise in supplying premium wall bed hardware mechanisms and providing precise technical guidance and installation support. featured_reviews.review_text:

featured_reviews.name: rajesh javalkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
False Claims of Wholesale Prices – Misleading Customers

I visited this hardware store expecting genuine wholesale prices, as they claim. However, that is completely untrue! The prices are just like any other retail shop, and in some cases, even higher. They are misleading customers by advertising “wholesale rates” when, in reality, they are charging regular market prices.

This is dishonest business practice, and customers deserve transparency. If you are looking for actual wholesale rates, I suggest checking other reliable stores instead of wasting time here.

I hope the store owners realize that misleading customers will only damage their reputation in the long run. Honest pricing and transparency would serve them much better.
